name: Silicate
description: AI level generator: describe a level, Gemini plans it, and Silicate builds and decorates it.

api-key.name: Gemini API key
api-key.description: Required. Free key from <cy>aistudio.google.com/apikey</c>. Stored only on this device.

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Limits gaps, spike widths and spacing the generator may use.
